suspended.ownerHint: Incoming messages are still being stored. Restore access to pick up where you left off.
suspended.memberHint: Incoming messages are still being stored. Ask a workspace owner or admin to restore access.

accessNotice.trial_ending: Your free trial ends on {date}. Choose a plan to keep your agent running.
accessNotice.payment_failed: Your last payment failed. Update your payment method before {lockDate} to avoid an interruption.
accessNotice.usage_warning: You've used {percent}% of your {included} included resolutions this period ({used} so far).
accessNotice.usage_exceeded: You've used all {included} included resolutions this period. Until {periodEnd} each extra resolution is billed at {rate}.
accessNotice.usage_paused: Your AI agent is paused: all {included} included resolutions for this period are used. Allow extra resolutions or upgrade to resume now; it restarts on its own on {periodEnd}.
accessNotice.usage_cap_reached: Your AI agent is paused: you reached your spend cap for extra resolutions this period ({used} of {cap}). New conversations go to your team. Raise the cap or upgrade to resume now; it restarts on its own on {periodEnd}.
accessNotice.trial_grace: Your free trial has ended and your AI agent is paused, so new conversations go to your team. Choose a plan before {lockDate} to switch it back on. After that date the account locks.
accessNotice.manual_suspension_pending: Your Hay.chat account will be suspended on {date}. Contact Hay.chat support if you have questions.
